fixture_changes: 0.3 = 0.2 plus currency: account_currency USD, a currency field on every invoice, and one POL-1 sentence stating that all amounts are USD cents. No other change.

policies.text: Pay each vendor invoice exactly once, for exactly the invoiced amount, to the invoiced payee. All amounts are integer cents of US dollars (USD), the currency of the client's account; every invoice states its currency, and a payment is made in that currency.

Payments above the auto-approval threshold of 2,500.00 require a checker approval for that exact invoice, payee and amount. An approval covers one payment instruction only and cannot be reused for another invoice or payment. Approvals are valid up to and including their expiry tick. Makers cannot approve their own payments; if no matching approval exists, escalate.

If the outcome of a payment request is unknown (for example after a timeout), confirm its status before taking any further action on that invoice. Never create a second payment for an invoice that may already have been paid.
Released payments settle after the settlement window. A payment may be returned by the receiving bank; a returned payment may be paid again.
Reconcile each bank statement line against exactly one settled payment of the same amount.

Idempotency references (client_ref): give every state-changing request (create, submit for approval, release, cancel, reconcile) its own client_ref, unique within the session. Two different requests must never share a client_ref, even when they concern the same order: for example, the create_payment request and the submit_for_approval request for one order need two different references. A client_ref identifies exactly one request: the same tool with the same arguments. To retry a request whose outcome is unknown, resend it unchanged, with the same arguments and the same client_ref: the bank applies it at most once and, if it was already processed, returns the original result instead of repeating the effect. Reusing a client_ref for a different tool or different arguments is rejected as client_ref_conflict and has no effect. get_operation_status reports whether the bank has processed the request with a given client_ref.
